mentions.name: Domain Intelligence Scanner
mentions.description: A browser-based toolkit for MSP and security work whose main project is a domain security assessment tool that combines DNS, WHOIS, MX, SPF, DKIM, DMARC, DNSSEC, TLS/SSL, security headers, redirects, and other public metadata into a single report with findings and recommendations. Smaller supporting tools are also being built around it for day-to-day IT work.
mentions.problem: Getting a quick picture of a domain required opening many different sites to gather information from scattered sources.
